evidence: Carries the 'Block storage' label and modifies block storage management and assumeutxo chainstate logic in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an assertion crash and false database corruption startup failure in assumeutxo workflows. If the snapshot base block is received before snapshot activation, background validation crashes on an assertion failure in WriteBlockUndo (`Assertion m_blockfile_cursors[type] failed`) or fails startup with an unrecoverable inconsistency error during VerifyDB.
